name: Equites Property Fund Limited
summary: Equites Property Fund Limited (Equites) is a South African REIT. It has a clear focus on being a market leader in the logistics property market by developing and acquiring A-grade, modern logistics facilities in prime locations in South Africa and the United Kingdom. Equites listed on the Johannesburg Stock Exchange (JSE) on 18 June 2014 with a portfolio value of R1 billion and has since grown to a portfolio value to R19.3 billion 28 February 2021. The group continues to grow its portfolio through a significant development pipeline and high-quality acquisitions.
